action.objective: Recapture the bishop on d3 with the queen, keeping material balance after Black's Bxd3.
action.rationale: d1d3 is the only commit_ready move: verified depth 2 with exact score 100, safety.complete (no mate-in-one), tactical_refutation not_found. Qxd3 recaptures the bishop, and f4 bishop plus e5 knight cover d3. Black likely answers with O-O or Bxe5, both manageable. No risk acceptance needed.
